dict.string: سُبْحَانَ الله
SubhanAllah
Whoever recites [the above] one Hundred times, a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away. [Muslim]
tasbeeh_0
Glory to God
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه
Alhamdulillah
The Prophet (SAW) said: Whoever reads Alhamdulillah 100 times – it will be as though he has participated in 100 Jihads.[Jame Tirmizi]
tasbeeh_1
Praise be to God
اَللهُ أَكْبَر
Allahu Akbar

The Prophet (SAW) said: whoever reads Allahuakbar 100 times in the morning and 100 times in the evening, on the Day of Judgment no one will be able to bring more good deeds than him, apart from the one who has read more. [Mishkat Sharif]
tasbeeh_2
God is the greatest
أَسْتَغْفِرُ الله
Astaghfir-Allah

If anyone constantly seeks pardon (from Allah), Allah will appoint for him a way out of every distress and a relief from every anxiety, and will provide sustenance for him from where he expects not. [Abu Dawud]
tasbeeh_3
I seek forgiveness from Allah
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحانَکَ، إِنِّيْ کُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِیْنَ.
La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz zualimin
So whoever Supplicates (asks ‘Dua’) with these words for Anything, Allah Almighty responds to him. [Jame Tirmizi]
tasbeeh_4
There is no god but You (O My Lord!). Glory be to You! Verily, I have been of the wrongdoers.
لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِالله
La hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah

Shall I not inform you of a statement, which is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise? I said: Yes O Messenger of Allaah, may my father and mother be sacrificed for you! He said: say: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
tasbeeh_5
There is no power nor strength except by Allah.
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا الله
La ilaha illa Allahu
The Messenger (P.B.U.H) said: 'The best way to mention Allah is [by saying] there is no god worthy of worship except for Allah'. at-Tirmidhl (no. 3383) and ibn Hibbiin in his Sahih (no. 846).
tasbeeh_6
There is no god but Allah
رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ
Rabb-ighfir li, wa tubb `alayya, innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.

Ibn 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with him and his father, said: 'We used to keep count of the Messenger of Allah ) in the one meeting [as saying] one hundred times: O my Lord! Forgive me and bestow repentance on me. You are the Ever-Forgiving the Most Merciful]'. Abu Dawoud (no. 1516) and atTirmidhl (no. 3430).
tasbeeh_7
O my Lord! Forgive me and bestow repentance on me. You are the Ever-Forgiving the Most Merciful
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِه
Subhana Allahi wa bi hamdihi.

Abi Dharr said that Messenger of Allah (P.B.U.H) said: 'Should I not tell you of the talk liked most by Allah? He said: 'I said: Yes, Messenger of Allah. Tell me of the talk liked most by Allah'. He said: 'The talk most liked by Allah is: Glory be to Allah and in Gratitude for Him I do glorify Him]'. Muslim (no. 3731).
tasbeeh_8
Glory be to Allah and in Gratitude for Him
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، وَلَا اِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَر
Subhanallah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar

Abu Hurayrah said that Messenger of Allah (P.B.U.H) said: 'To say: Glory be to Allah, gratitude be to Allah, there is no god worthy of worship except for Allah and Allah is the Greatest] is better to me than all that the sun rose on. Muslim (no. 2695).
tasbeeh_9
Glory be to Allah, Gratitude be to Allah, there is no god worthy of worship except for Allah and Allah is the Greatest
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِيْ ، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
Allahum maghfirli warhamni wahdini Warzuqni

Sa' d ibn abi Waqqas said: ' A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah (P.B.U.H) and said: 'Tell me something that I should say'. He said: 'Say: O Allah! Forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me and provide for me]'. Muslim (No.1007).
tasbeeh_10
O Allah! Forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me and provide for me
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، وَلَا اِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
Subhanallah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah

Abdullah ibn abi Awfa, may Allah be pleased with him and his father said: 'A man came to the Messenger ) and said: 'I cannot learn anything of the Qur'an. Tell me something that I can say in its place'. He said: 'Say: Glorified be Allah, Gratitude be to Allah, there is no god worthy of worship except for Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no ability or power except by Allah]'. Abu Dawoud (no. 832).
tasbeeh_11
Glorified be Allah, Gratitude be to Allah, there is no god worthy of worship except for Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no ability or power except by Allah]'.
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
La ilaha illalah wahdahu la sharika lahu lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu, wahuwa 'ala kulli shay 'in qadirun.

Abu Hurayrah said that Messenger of Allah( P.B.U.H) said: 'Whoever says: There is no god worthy of worship except for Allah, alone without an associate. To Him is sovereignty and gratitude. He has power over everything], one hundred times in one day will get a r eward equal to [that of] manumitting ten slaves; one hundred !.!asanahs will be recorded for him; one hundred sayyi'ahs will be stuck off; it will be a shield for him from the Devil on that day till night, and; no one will have b ettered what he did except that who did more than him' . al-Bukhari (no. 6403) and Muslim (no. 2691).
tasbeeh_12

There is no god worthy of worship except for Allah, alone without an associate. To Him is sovereignty and gratitude. He has power over everything], one hundred times in one day will get a r eward equal to [that of] manumitting ten slaves; one hundred !.!asanahs will be recorded for him; one hundred sayyi'ahs will be stuck off; it will be a shield for him from the Devil on that day till night, and; no one will have b ettered what he did except that who did more than him'
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيْم
Subhanallahi Wa Bihamdihi Subhanallahil Azeem

Abu Hurayrah said that Messenger of Allah (P.B.U.H) said: 'Two expressions [which are], light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and dear to the Most Merciful: Glory be to Allah and in Gratitude for Him I do glorify Him. Glory be to Allah, the Most Great]'. al-Bukhari (no. 6406) and Muslim (no. 2694)
tasbeeh_13
Glory be to Allah and in Gratitude for Him I do glorify Him. Glory be to Allah, the Most Great]'.
بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ.
Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma’as-mihi shai’un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama’i, wa Huwas-Sami’ul-‘Alim

Uthman bin ‘Affan (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said, “He who recites three times every morning and evening: ‘Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma’as-mihi shai’un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama’i, wa Huwas-Sami’ul-‘Alim (In the Name of Allah with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm in the earth or in the heaven, and He is the All-Hearing and All- Knowing),’ nothing will harm him.”
tasbeeh_14
In the name of Allah with Whose Name nothing on earth or in heaven harms and He is the All-Hearing the All-Knowing and is then harmed by anything.
يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيْثُ
Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, bi-Rahmatika astagheeth

Anas bin Malik said: “Whenever a matter would distress him, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say: ‘O Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief (ya hayyu ya qayyum birahmatika astaghees).”
tasbeeh_15
O Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief (ya hayyu ya qayyum birahmatika astaghees
أَعُـوْذُ بِكَلِمَـاتِ اللهِ التَّـامَّـاتِ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما خَلَـقَ.
A‘udhu bi kalimat Allaah al-taammaat min sharri ma khalaq

Abu Hurayrah ) said: 'A man came to the Prophet ) and said: 'Messenger of Allah! I suffered from a scorpion that stung me last night'. He said: 'If you had said at nightfall: I seek refuge in Allah's Prefect Words from the evil of what He has created] it would not have harmed you'. Muslim (no. 2709).
tasbeeh_16
If you had said at nightfall: I seek refuge in Allah's Prefect Words from the evil of what He has created] it would not have harmed you'. Muslim (no. 2709).
سُوْرَةُ الإِخْلَاصِ، سُوْرَةُ الفَلَقِ، سُوْرَةُ النَّاسِ
Surah Ikhlas, Surah Falaq, Surah Naas

Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi wa Sallam) said: Recite Surah al-Ikhlas and two last Surahs of the Qur'an, in the morning and evening three times, and it will suffice you for everything. Sunan Abu Dawood 5082 and Sunan At-Tirmidhi: 3575
tasbeeh_17
اَللّٰهُمَّ أَعِنِّيْ عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ.
Allâhumma a’innî alâ dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni ‘ibâdatika

Mu’adh (رضي الله عنه) reported: The Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) took hold of my hand and said, “O Mu’adh! By Allah I love you, so I advise you to never forget to recite after every prayer:
tasbeeh_18
O Allah, help me remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in an excellent manner”
رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
Rabbana iitina fi d-dunya hasanatan wa .fi liikhirati hasanatan wa qind 'adhdba n-nari.
Anas (R.A) said: 'The most oft-repeated supplication of the Prophet (P.B.U.H) was:
tasbeeh_19
Our Lord! Give us in this life that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and save us from the torment of the Fire]'. al-Buk:harl (no. 6389) and Muslim (no. 2690).

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ. اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ.

Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad(in), kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm(a), innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd. Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad(in), kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm(a), innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.

The famous companion of the Messenger of Allah Prophet Muhammad Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam (Peace and Blessings of Allah be upon him), Hazrat Ka’ab bin Ujrah (radi Allahu anhu), narrates that once it was enquired from Sayyiduna Rasoolullah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam ) as to how blessings should be sent to him. The Messenger of Allah Prophet Muhammad Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam replied that the blessings be said in the manner (it has been mentioned) above, that is, Durood-e-Ibrahim.
Reference: Sahih Al-Bukhari Vol 4 Book 55, #590
tasbeeh_20

O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad just as You have sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim, verily You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad just as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, verily You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
